sections.title: Production Rate Limiter
sections.body:
```python
import asyncio
import time
from collections import deque

class AsyncRateLimiter:
    """
    Token bucket rate limiter.
    Allows 'rate' operations per 'period' seconds.
    """

    def __init__(self, rate: int, period: float = 1.0):
        self.rate   = rate
        self.period = period
        self._tokens = rate
        self._last_refill = time.monotonic()
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._waiters: deque = deque()

    async def acquire(self):
        async with self._lock:
            now = time.monotonic()
            elapsed = now - self._last_refill

            # Refill tokens based on elapsed time
            if elapsed >= self.period:
                self._tokens = self.rate
                self._last_refill = now
            elif elapsed > 0:
                new_tokens = int(elapsed / self.period * self.rate)
                self._tokens = min(self.rate, self._tokens + new_tokens)
                if new_tokens > 0:
                    self._last_refill = now

            if self._tokens > 0:
                self._tokens -= 1
                return  # Token available — proceed immediately

        # No token available — wait
        wait_time = self.period / self.rate
        await asyncio.sleep(wait_time)
        await self.acquire()  # Try again after waiting

    async def __aenter__(self):
        await self.acquire()
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, *args):
        pass

# Usage
async def main():
    limiter = AsyncRateLimiter(rate=5, period=1.0)  # 5 requests/second

    async def rate_limited_api_call(call_id: int):
        async with limiter:
            timestamp = time.monotonic()
            print(f"  Call {call_id:2d} at t={timestamp:.3f}s")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.05)  # Simulate API call

    start = time.monotonic()
    await asyncio.gather(*[rate_limited_api_call(i) for i in range(20)])
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
    print(f"\n20 calls in {elapsed:.2f}s (expected ~4s at 5/sec)")

asyncio.run(main())
```
